Title: New subscription purchase option for StorSimple

Body.Content:
A new subscription option for Microsoft Azure StorSimple 8000 Series, StorSimple Virtual Array, and StorSimple Cloud Appliance is now available.

By using this option, under an Enterprise Agreement, Enterprise Subscription, and Enrollment for Education Solutions, you can subscribe to StorSimple and get standard support for a fixed annual fee. There won’t be ongoing variable fees for usage of the device (though Azure storage costs are not included).

This option provides several benefits:

  • Additional flexibility and simplicity in purchasing and using StorSimple.
  • Lower StorSimple entry price relative to the current Azure Storage Acceleration Program (ASAP+).
  • As storage needs grow, maintenance costs will not. (Again, Azure storage costs are not included.)

For more details, see the StorSimple pricing page or talk to your Microsoft sales team.
